description: How the viewer presents its search UI on desktop and tablet layouts, driven by TmPdfViewer.SearchPresentation. Floating (the default since 2.9.1) anchors a role=search card top-right over the page body — outside the scroll area and never covering the toolbar; Escape closes it and returns focus to the toolbar's search toggle. Inline restores the pre-2.9.1 full-width bar under the toolbar. A mobile layout always keeps the in-flow (sheet-style) bar regardless of this value.
